name: NB_Hosted_MCP_EvalSuite
description: Hosted nextbillion-mcp (https://mcp.nextbillion.io, v0.5.3, 27 tools). Ports the cases from Nextbillion-MCPEval_KB_Suite-Master and NB_offcl_KB_Tools_EvalSuite, plus new cases for the geometry tools (bbox, buffer, centroid, measure, nearest, points_in_polygon, polygon_ops) and newer routing/search options. Model: Claude Sonnet 4.5.
